raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Add a user-tested launch recipe for `nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4` on NVIDIA RTX Spark to the existing Qwen3.6 cookbook page. The config uses the shared Deployment component and preserves the reported command, including `extra_buffer`, memory fraction `0.8`, and `flashinfer_cutlass`.

The contributor reports **75 output tokens/s for a single request on SGLang `main`**. The page records this as generation speed; no P50 TPOT or aggregate throughput is inferred. The exact commit, workload lengths, runtime, and device memory configuration were not supplied. The nightly Docker fallback is labeled separately from the tested environment.

RTX Spark is declared in this model's `config.hardware`; hardware naming and published platform specifications are sourced from [NVIDIA](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/). This adds only the scoped recipe and does not migrate the existing legacy selector (the broader migration is already covered by #32959).

Validation:
- `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passed.
- `mint validate` passed.
- `mint broken-links` passed.
- Shared-engine bare command output matches the contributor's command exactly after whitespace normalization.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Local browser preview verified the RTX Spark selector, exact launch command, and 75 tokens/s note.

The GPU benchmark was reported by the contributor, not rerun locally.

files.patch:
@@ -101,6 +101,24 @@ This section provides deployment configurations optimized for different hardware
 
 <Qwen36Deployment />
 
+### RTX Spark: 35B-A3B NVFP4
+
+Select **RTX Spark** in the generator above to use the single-node, single-GPU recipe for
+[nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4)
+on [NVIDIA RTX Spark](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/products/rtx-spark/), which
+pairs a Blackwell RTX GPU with a Grace CPU and offers up to 128GB of unified
+memory. The contributor tested this command on SGLang `main`. The recipe uses
+the FlashInfer CUTLASS MoE runner,
+`extra_buffer` Mamba radix caching, and a static memory fraction of `0.8`.
+Speculative decoding is not enabled.
+
+The contributor reported **75 output tokens/s for a single request** on SGLang
+`main`. The exact commit, OS/runtime, memory configuration, input/output lengths,
+and timing method were not provided. This is a reported generation speed, not
+an input-plus-output throughput measurement or a measured P50 TPOT. The Docker
+selector uses the nightly `dev` fallback; that image was not the reported test
+environment.
+
 ### 3.2 Configuration Tips
 
 - Speculative decoding (MTP) can significantly reduce latency for interactive use cases.
